statement: Article 14 reporting applies from 11 Sep 2026 to all in-scope products, including those placed on the market before 11 Dec 2027.
Chapter IV (notification of conformity assessment bodies) applies from 11 Jun 2026; all other provisions from 11 Dec 2027.

Reporting clocks: actively exploited vulnerability 24h early warning, 72h notification, final report 14 days after a corrective measure is available; severe incident 24h, 72h, final report within 1 month after submission of the incident notification.

fact: Harmonised standards cited in the OJ
statement: No harmonised standard is cited in the OJ and no common specification is adopted (30 Oct 2026); Class I products can use Module A only by applying in full a cited harmonised standard
basis: a common specification or a European cybersecurity certification scheme at assurance level at least 'substantial' (Art 32(2)); otherwise Module B+C or H.

statement: No CRA notified body was verifiably designated in NANDO at checks to 8 Sep 2026; Member States must 'strive' for enough bodies by 11 Dec 2026.
The Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market or put into service after 9 Dec 2026 (Art 2(1)); software is a product and a vulnerability can be a defect.
